30 min (plus the time to clear the dragon lair)

A forgotten secret is guarded by fire and dark walls in the dragon lair north of Ankrahmun. With the {item:Chayenne's Magical Key} and the book {item:Key to Magic (Book)|Key to Magic} from Draconia, you clear the whole lair, reveal a hidden lever and enter the {wiki:Realm of Dreams|Realm of Dreams}, where a {item:Beach Backpack} full of memories awaits you.
Guarded by fire and dark walls, a long-forgotten secret lies...
Level 40 (60 recommended); there is a level 40 {item:Gate of Expertise} in the Realm of Dreams.
Have the {item:Chayenne's Magical Key} in your backpack (it is not destroyed when you enter).
Have opened the {item:Treasure Chest (Blue)|Treasure Chest} in {wiki:Draconia|Draconia} and received the book {item:Key to Magic (Book)|Key to Magic} (you don't need to carry it with you).
{spell:Levitate} spell (to reach the top of the Draconia pyramid)
for the Hellgate door, on the way to Draconia ({npc:Elathriel} sells it for 5000 gp)
optional: exchange it for a Dragonfetish to leave Draconia
This quest is **not fully understood**: the steps below worked for some players but not for others.

The spawn must be **100% respawned** before you start killing, otherwise it doesn't work. The {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} on the lower floor and the ones beneath the elementals take a long time to respawn.
Bring fire protection and lots of potions: you will clear 14 Dragons, 8 Dragon Lords and 7 Fire Elementals.
To be safer, do the quest right after server save instead of after a floor reset.

{wiki:Draconia} is an island off Ab'Dendriel with no boat: you can only reach it through the {wiki:Hellgate}. In **Ab'Dendriel** go down to the {wiki:Shadow Caves} (underground, **northwest** of the depot), go down 2 more floors and head **south** and **east** to the Hellgate door; open it with the {item:Key 3012} (the guard {npc:Elathriel}, nearby, sells it for 5000 gp). Step into the **north** teleport and follow the route to the {wiki:Redbone Castle}; from there the path is **one-way** to the surface of Draconia. The complete route, with maps, is in the {wiki:Draconia Quest}.

In the Hellgate there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and sometimes {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}.

Travel to {wiki:Draconia|Draconia} and use {spell:Levitate} to go up to the top of the pyramid. Open the {item:Treasure Chest (Blue)|Treasure Chest}: it has the book {item:Key to Magic (Book)|Key to Magic}, with clues for the next part.
Without having picked up this book you **can't enter** the Realm of Dreams.

Draconia has no normal exit. You have two options: **(1)** take a {item:White Mushroom} to {npc:An Old Dragonlord}, at the top of the mountain in the north of the island, and greet him ({key:hi}) to exchange it for a {item:Dragonfetish}; sacrifice it in the exit teleport room, in the dragon lair beneath the **southeast** of the island, and you are teleported to **Ab'Dendriel**. **(2)** Walk back: go down to the Redbone Castle and leave by the normal Hellgate route ({wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}), with a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}) to go up 2 floors; you come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel. (The portal on the 7th floor of the pyramid only opens with the keys from the {wiki:Draconia Quest}.)
You only receive one Dragonfetish: if you lose it before using it you don't get another. In the teleport room there is a {creature:Dragon}.
2. Clearing the northern Ankrahmun dragon lair

Go to the {wiki:Ankrahmun Dragon Lairs|northern Ankrahmun dragon lair} (the hardest of the three, in {wiki:Kha'labal}, the desert north of Ankrahmun; you walk there from the city) and kill **all** the {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}. Use the table to confirm you killed the right amount on each floor.
If the spawn isn't complete when you start, the mechanism doesn't work. Make sure **no** creature is left alive.
On the top floor there is a switch on the floor covered by a {item:Fire Field}. Use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} on it: the switch appears.
You may need to use Destroy Field first on the fire **immediately to the right** of the switch and only then on the one on the switch. Some say the one on the switch is enough; bring runes for both.
Step on the switch. The pile of stones above it disappears and reveals a lever.
Ankrahmun dragon lair without the fire: the switch already pressed and the lever covered by the stones
Use the lever and go **south**: a {item:Magic Wall} should have disappeared.

The Magic Wall comes back 5 minutes after you use the lever. The pile of stones doesn't come back until the next {wiki:Floor Reset|floor reset}: if the walls are closed and there are no stones over the lever, just use it again.
The lever that is visible after you step on the switch
With the {item:Chayenne's Magical Key} in your backpack (and having picked up the book in Draconia), step into the {item:Magic Forcefield}. You are sent to the {wiki:Realm of Dreams|Realm of Dreams}.
Follow the path until you reach a small island and then go **northeast**. Pass the level 40 {item:Gate of Expertise}. The reward is inside a {item:Dead Dragon} on the **second floor**.
Because of Quick Looting, right-clicking the body may not open the body. If that happens, use **Ctrl + left click** and choose "Open".
Beach Backpack with Music Box, Blue Rose, Dracoyle Statue, Black Pearl, Red Dragon Scale, Stuffed Dragon, Piggy Bank and Surprise Bag (Blue)

To leave, use the gate to the **northwest** of the island (the wiki's location page says **northeast** — if you don't see it in the northwest, look in the northeast). You return to the dragon lair entrance. From there walk **south**, across the desert, back to Ankrahmun.
You don't need to have used Chayenne's {item:Anniversary Remains} during Tibia's 15th anniversary.
Sometimes a floor reset isn't enough to unlock the lever: some players cleared the whole lair after a floor reset several times in the same day without success. Waiting for server save is safer.
